{"content":"### Root Cause

When a background structured compaction (`CompactionEngine.structured`) hit its 300s budget watchdog — or a gateway 504/disconnect the engine could not recover from — `AutoCompactorFactory.run()` failed fast (`hooks.onBothRolesFailed` + `return false`) in the `outcome.timedOut` branch (`lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart`). The over-window continuation funnel read `false` as "compaction exhausted" and aborted the live task (`the transcript is still ~X tokens vs a Y-token window — N compaction passes did not free it`), even though the session file kept every record and a mechanical rescue path already existed.

### Fix

- `lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart`: added `AutoCompactor.applyLocalTrimFallback({int pass})` — applies the same `_localTrimFallback()` valve the classic pass ladder ends on (keeps the most recent `keepRecentTokens`, repairs tool pairing, prefixes the `[context trimmed locally]` marker), fires the `local-trim` pass receipt and closes the `onDone` bracket exactly once. The factory's `timedOut` branch now applies this fallback instead of aborting; the both-roles-failed verdict is kept only when nothing is droppable.
- `CHANGELOG.md`: `fix(gh-1743)` entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/agent/auto_compactor_structured_budget_test.dart`:
  - `gh-1743: a factory-level budget timeout (wedged judge past the total budget) falls back to the local trim instead of aborting the session` — reproduction test, **failed before the fix** (`ok: false`), now passes: run rescued, `local-trim` pass receipt, `onDone` fired once, tokens shrank, transcript starts at the trim marker, tool pairing intact, session records untouched (14 kept).
  - `gh-1743: when nothing is droppable the budget timeout keeps the failure verdict` — pins the honest failure path (no trim → `onBothRolesFailed` + `false`, no context change).
- Full suite: pending at PR time — see CI.

### Notes

- Behavior on other timeout shapes is unchanged: a per-call budget kill the structured engine recovers from (#515/#541) still resolves inside the engine; a non-timeout structured failure still falls through to the classic engine.
- The trim is in-memory only — the session JSONL keeps the full history; the next restart replays it and the pre-flight compaction retries the LLM path.

    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a

  attempts' min ratios to a 3.30x best against the 3.2 bound while the
  real 500k growth legs on the same runner stayed green). 3-of-5 is the
  documented live-red shape ("≥3 of the 5 timed runs"): median-of-5
  [c,c,s] is still a spiked value, so the leg still proves the
  pre-gh-1532 median harness fails, and the min harness now rides two

{"content":"### Root Cause

When a background structured compaction (`CompactionEngine.structured`) hit its 300s budget watchdog — or a gateway 504/disconnect the engine could not recover from — `AutoCompactorFactory.run()` failed fast (`hooks.onBothRolesFailed` + `return false`) in the `outcome.timedOut` branch (`lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart`). The over-window continuation funnel read `false` as "compaction exhausted" and aborted the live task (`the transcript is still ~X tokens vs a Y-token window — N compaction passes did not free it`), even though the session file kept every record and a mechanical rescue path already existed.

### Fix

- `lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart`: added `AutoCompactor.applyLocalTrimFallback({int pass})` — applies the same `_localTrimFallback()` valve the classic pass ladder ends on (keeps the most recent `keepRecentTokens`, repairs tool pairing, prefixes the `[context trimmed locally]` marker), fires the `local-trim` pass receipt and closes the `onDone` bracket exactly once. The factory's `timedOut` branch now applies this fallback instead of aborting; the both-roles-failed verdict is kept only when nothing is droppable.
- `CHANGELOG.md`: `fix(gh-1743)` entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/agent/auto_compactor_structured_budget_test.dart`:
  - `gh-1743: a factory-level budget timeout (wedged judge past the total budget) falls back to the local trim instead of aborting the session` — reproduction test, **failed before the fix** (`ok: false`), now passes: run rescued, `local-trim` pass receipt, `onDone` fired once, tokens shrank, transcript starts at the trim marker, tool pairing intact, session records untouched (14 kept).
  - `gh-1743: when nothing is droppable the budget timeout keeps the failure verdict` — pins the honest failure path (no trim → `onBothRolesFailed` + `false`, no context change).
- Full suite: pending at PR time — see CI.

### Notes

- Behavior on other timeout shapes is unchanged: a per-call budget kill the structured engine recovers from (#515/#541) still resolves inside the engine; a non-timeout structured failure still falls through to the classic engine.
- The trim is in-memory only — the session JSONL keeps the full history; the next restart replays it and the pre-flight compaction retries the LLM path.

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:
    # dart test --tags io
  perf:
    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open
    # budgets. Selected by --tags integration in CI; run standalone with
    # dart test --tags perf
  reg-parity:
    # omp REG parity suite (issue #810): structural diff of the committed
    # omp reference twins vs fa's pure-Dart engine renders. Fast, hermetic
    # (no PTY, no network), SKIPs when the fixtures are not captured yet.
    # Merge-blocking through the EXISTING legs: ci.yml test-core (dart test
    # runs it) and the pty-visual job (fa_omp_reg_visual_test.dart) both
    # aggregate into Quality gate; the pre-commit hook's test-core stage
    # runs the same suite, so hook/CI marker parity holds with no new
    # stage. Standalone: dart test test/cli/omp_reg_parity_test.dart

# Changelog

Older entries: [CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md](CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md) — moved out
on 2026-10-09 (gh-1452): pub.dev server-rejects a publish whose
CHANGELOG.md exceeds its 262144-byte content cap, so this file keeps a
bounded recent window and `scripts/check_changelog_size.sh` fails fast when the cap is
approached. Since gh-1522 this file is CURATED-ONLY: add new lines under
`## Unreleased` and the release folds them into the tag's section at
publish-staging time — the published artifact's changelog is generated
(and trimmed under the cap by `stamp_staged_release.sh`), and the
publish job only WARNS on this repo file, so this file's size can never
block a release again.

## Unreleased

- fix(gh-1636): auto-compaction stops dumping the internal checkpoint
  summary into the console — the default report is ONE marker line
  (`● auto-compacted · engine: N → M tokens (F freed · P%)`); the records
  line + fenced summary moved behind the new `tui.showCompactionDetails`
  opt-in (default false), and the manual `/compact` still prints the full
  block. The headless log face no longer streams the summarizer deltas by
  default (the gh-1433 E4 live stream is part of the same opt-in; the
  gh-1430 `… reasoning` liveness line still covers the window). Nothing
  is lost — the summary stays in the session file, reachable via
  `compact_expand`.

- fix(test): gh-1732 — the `wrap_ansi_line_perf_test` sustained-contention
  validation leg spikes 3 of the 5 doubled runs per attempt instead of 4
  (CI run 39546301132, core shard 2/4: the old shape left exactly ONE
  real-wall-clock-timed doubled sample per attempt, and real jitter on
  that single sample — the very shape being modeled — inflated all three
  attempts' min ratios to a 3.30x best against the 3.2 bound while the
  real 500k growth legs on the same runner stayed green). 3-of-5 is the
  documented live-red shape ("≥3 of the 5 timed runs"): median-of-5
  [c,c,s] is still a spiked value, so the leg still proves the
  pre-gh-1532 median harness fails, and the min harness now rides two
  clean doubled samples per attempt.

- fix(#1705): CLI fresh-install boarding asks the provider choice FIRST —
  the same list the `/add-provider` picker shows (presets, `Custom` last) —

{"content":"### Root Cause

When a background structured compaction (`CompactionEngine.structured`) hit its 300s budget watchdog — or a gateway 504/disconnect the engine could not recover from — `AutoCompactorFactory.run()` failed fast (`hooks.onBothRolesFailed` + `return false`) in the `outcome.timedOut` branch (`lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart`). The over-window continuation funnel read `false` as "compaction exhausted" and aborted the live task (`the transcript is still ~X tokens vs a Y-token window — N compaction passes did not free it`), even though the session file kept every record and a mechanical rescue path already existed.

### Fix

- `lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart`: added `AutoCompactor.applyLocalTrimFallback({int pass})` — applies the same `_localTrimFallback()` valve the classic pass ladder ends on (keeps the most recent `keepRecentTokens`, repairs tool pairing, prefixes the `[context trimmed locally]` marker), fires the `local-trim` pass receipt and closes the `onDone` bracket exactly once. The factory's `timedOut` branch now applies this fallback instead of aborting; the both-roles-failed verdict is kept only when nothing is droppable.
- `CHANGELOG.md`: `fix(gh-1743)` entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/agent/auto_compactor_structured_budget_test.dart`:
  - `gh-1743: a factory-level budget timeout (wedged judge past the total budget) falls back to the local trim instead of aborting the session` — reproduction test, **failed before the fix** (`ok: false`), now passes: run rescued, `local-trim` pass receipt, `onDone` fired once, tokens shrank, transcript starts at the trim marker, tool pairing intact, session records untouched (14 kept).
  - `gh-1743: when nothing is droppable the budget timeout keeps the failure verdict` — pins the honest failure path (no trim → `onBothRolesFailed` + `false`, no context change).
- Full suite: pending at PR time — see CI.

### Notes

- Behavior on other timeout shapes is unchanged: a per-call budget kill the structured engine recovers from (#515/#541) still resolves inside the engine; a non-timeout structured failure still falls through to the classic engine.
- The trim is in-memory only — the session JSONL keeps the full history; the next restart replays it and the pre-flight compaction retries the LLM path.

    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need

    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run

    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.

publish-staging time — the published artifact's changelog is generated
(and trimmed under the cap by `stamp_staged_release.sh`), and the
publish job only WARNS on this repo file, so this file's size can never
block a release again.

## Unreleased

- fix(gh-1636): auto-compaction stops dumping the internal checkpoint
  summary into the console — the default report is ONE marker line

  line + fenced summary moved behind the new `tui.showCompactionDetails`

  is lost — the summary stays in the session file, reachable via

  attempts' min ratios to a 3.30x best against the 3.2 bound while the
  real 500k growth legs on the same runner stayed green). 3-of-5 is the
  documented live-red shape ("≥3 of the 5 timed runs"): median-of-5
  [c,c,s] is still a spiked value, so the leg still proves the
  pre-gh-1532 median harness fails, and the min harness now rides two
  clean doubled samples per attempt.

- fix(#1705): CLI fresh-install boarding asks the provider choice FIRST —

{"content":"### Root Cause

When a background structured compaction (`CompactionEngine.structured`) hit its 300s budget watchdog — or a gateway 504/disconnect the engine could not recover from — `AutoCompactorFactory.run()` failed fast (`hooks.onBothRolesFailed` + `return false`) in the `outcome.timedOut` branch (`lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart`). The over-window continuation funnel read `false` as "compaction exhausted" and aborted the live task (`the transcript is still ~X tokens vs a Y-token window — N compaction passes did not free it`), even though the session file kept every record and a mechanical rescue path already existed.

### Fix

- `lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart`: added `AutoCompactor.applyLocalTrimFallback({int pass})` — applies the same `_localTrimFallback()` valve the classic pass ladder ends on (keeps the most recent `keepRecentTokens`, repairs tool pairing, prefixes the `[context trimmed locally]` marker), fires the `local-trim` pass receipt and closes the `onDone` bracket exactly once. The factory's `timedOut` branch now applies this fallback instead of aborting; the both-roles-failed verdict is kept only when nothing is droppable.
- `CHANGELOG.md`: `fix(gh-1743)` entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/agent/auto_compactor_structured_budget_test.dart`:
  - `gh-1743: a factory-level budget timeout (wedged judge past the total budget) falls back to the local trim instead of aborting the session` — reproduction test, **failed before the fix** (`ok: false`), now passes: run rescued, `local-trim` pass receipt, `onDone` fired once, tokens shrank, transcript starts at the trim marker, tool pairing intact, session records untouched (14 kept).
  - `gh-1743: when nothing is droppable the budget timeout keeps the failure verdict` — pins the honest failure path (no trim → `onBothRolesFailed` + `false`, no context change).
- Full suite: pending at PR time — see CI.

### Notes

- Behavior on other timeout shapes is unchanged: a per-call budget kill the structured engine recovers from (#515/#541) still resolves inside the engine; a non-timeout structured failure still falls through to the classic engine.
- The trim is in-memory only — the session JSONL keeps the full history; the next restart replays it and the pre-flight compaction retries the LLM path.

    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the

    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty

    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are

# Changelog

Older entries: [CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md](CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md) — moved out
on 2026-10-09 (gh-1452): pub.dev server-rejects a publish whose
CHANGELOG.md exceeds its 262144-byte content cap, so this file keeps a
bounded recent window and `scripts/check_changelog_size.sh` fails fast when the cap is
approached. Since gh-1522 this file is CURATED-ONLY: add new lines under
`## Unreleased` and the release folds them into the tag's section at
publish-staging time — the published artifact's changelog is generated
(and trimmed under the cap by `stamp_staged_release.sh`), and the
publish job only WARNS on this repo file, so this file's size can never
block a release again.

## Unreleased

- fix(gh-1636): auto-compaction stops dumping the internal checkpoint
  summary into the console — the default report is ONE marker line
  (`● auto-compacted · engine: N → M tokens (F freed · P%)`); the records
  line + fenced summary moved behind the new `tui.showCompactionDetails`
  opt-in (default false), and the manual `/compact` still prints the full
  block. The headless log face no longer streams the summarizer deltas by
  default (the gh-1433 E4 live stream is part of the same opt-in; the
  gh-1430 `… reasoning` liveness line still covers the window). Nothing
  is lost — the summary stays in the session file, reachable via
  `compact_expand`.

- fix(test): gh-1732 — the `wrap_ansi_line_perf_test` sustained-contention
  validation leg spikes 3 of the 5 doubled runs per attempt instead of 4
  (CI run 39546301132, core shard 2/4: the old shape left exactly ONE
  real-wall-clock-timed doubled sample per attempt, and real jitter on
  that single sample — the very shape being modeled — inflated all three
  attempts' min ratios to a 3.30x best against the 3.2 bound while the
  real 500k growth legs on the same runner stayed green). 3-of-5 is the
  documented live-red shape ("≥3 of the 5 timed runs"): median-of-5
  [c,c,s] is still a spiked value, so the leg still proves the
  pre-gh-1532 median harness fails, and the min harness now rides two
  clean doubled samples per attempt.

- fix(#1705): CLI fresh-install boarding asks the provider choice FIRST —
  the same list the `/add-provider` picker shows (presets, `Custom` last) —

{"content":"### Root Cause

When a background structured compaction (`CompactionEngine.structured`) hit its 300s budget watchdog — or a gateway 504/disconnect the engine could not recover from — `AutoCompactorFactory.run()` failed fast (`hooks.onBothRolesFailed` + `return false`) in the `outcome.timedOut` branch (`lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart`). The over-window continuation funnel read `false` as "compaction exhausted" and aborted the live task (`the transcript is still ~X tokens vs a Y-token window — N compaction passes did not free it`), even though the session file kept every record and a mechanical rescue path already existed.

### Fix

- `lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart`: added `AutoCompactor.applyLocalTrimFallback({int pass})` — applies the same `_localTrimFallback()` valve the classic pass ladder ends on (keeps the most recent `keepRecentTokens`, repairs tool pairing, prefixes the `[context trimmed locally]` marker), fires the `local-trim` pass receipt and closes the `onDone` bracket exactly once. The factory's `timedOut` branch now applies this fallback instead of aborting; the both-roles-failed verdict is kept only when nothing is droppable.
- `CHANGELOG.md`: `fix(gh-1743)` entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/agent/auto_compactor_structured_budget_test.dart`:
  - `gh-1743: a factory-level budget timeout (wedged judge past the total budget) falls back to the local trim instead of aborting the session` — reproduction test, **failed before the fix** (`ok: false`), now passes: run rescued, `local-trim` pass receipt, `onDone` fired once, tokens shrank, transcript starts at the trim marker, tool pairing intact, session records untouched (14 kept).
  - `gh-1743: when nothing is droppable the budget timeout keeps the failure verdict` — pins the honest failure path (no trim → `onBothRolesFailed` + `false`, no context change).
- Full suite: pending at PR time — see CI.

### Notes

- Behavior on other timeout shapes is unchanged: a per-call budget kill the structured engine recovers from (#515/#541) still resolves inside the engine; a non-timeout structured failure still falls through to the classic engine.
- The trim is in-memory only — the session JSONL keeps the full history; the next restart replays it and the pre-flight compaction retries the LLM path.

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded

    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty

    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:

# Changelog

CHANGELOG.md exceeds its 262144-byte content cap, so this file keeps a
bounded recent window and `scripts/check_changelog_size.sh` fails fast when the cap is
approached. Since gh-1522 this file is CURATED-ONLY: add new lines under
`## Unreleased` and the release folds them into the tag's section at
publish-staging time — the published artifact's changelog is generated
(and trimmed under the cap by `stamp_staged_release.sh`), and the
publish job only WARNS on this repo file, so this file's size can never
block a release again.

## Unreleased

- fix(gh-1636): auto-compaction stops dumping the internal checkpoint
  summary into the console — the default report is ONE marker line
  (`● auto-compacted · engine: N → M tokens (F freed · P%)`); the records
  line + fenced summary moved behind the new `tui.showCompactionDetails`
  opt-in (default false), and the manual `/compact` still prints the full
  block. The headless log face no longer streams the summarizer deltas by
  default (the gh-1433 E4 live stream is part of the same opt-in; the
  gh-1430 `… reasoning` liveness line still covers the window). Nothing
  is lost — the summary stays in the session file, reachable via
  `compact_expand`.

- fix(test): gh-1732 — the `wrap_ansi_line_perf_test` sustained-contention
  validation leg spikes 3 of the 5 doubled runs per attempt instead of 4
  (CI run 39546301132, core shard 2/4: the old shape left exactly ONE
  real-wall-clock-timed doubled sample per attempt, and real jitter on
  that single sample — the very shape being modeled — inflated all three
  attempts' min ratios to a 3.30x best against the 3.2 bound while the
  real 500k growth legs on the same runner stayed green). 3-of-5 is the
  documented live-red shape ("≥3 of the 5 timed runs"): median-of-5
  [c,c,s] is still a spiked value, so the leg still proves the
  pre-gh-1532 median harness fails, and the min harness now rides two
  clean doubled samples per attempt.

- fix(#1705): CLI fresh-install boarding asks the provider choice FIRST —
  the same list the `/add-provider` picker shows (presets, `Custom` last) —

{"content":"### Root Cause

When a background structured compaction (`CompactionEngine.structured`) hit its 300s budget watchdog — or a gateway 504/disconnect the engine could not recover from — `AutoCompactorFactory.run()` failed fast (`hooks.onBothRolesFailed` + `return false`) in the `outcome.timedOut` branch (`lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart`). The over-window continuation funnel read `false` as "compaction exhausted" and aborted the live task (`the transcript is still ~X tokens vs a Y-token window — N compaction passes did not free it`), even though the session file kept every record and a mechanical rescue path already existed.

### Fix

- `lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart`: added `AutoCompactor.applyLocalTrimFallback({int pass})` — applies the same `_localTrimFallback()` valve the classic pass ladder ends on (keeps the most recent `keepRecentTokens`, repairs tool pairing, prefixes the `[context trimmed locally]` marker), fires the `local-trim` pass receipt and closes the `onDone` bracket exactly once. The factory's `timedOut` branch now applies this fallback instead of aborting; the both-roles-failed verdict is kept only when nothing is droppable.
- `CHANGELOG.md`: `fix(gh-1743)` entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/agent/auto_compactor_structured_budget_test.dart`:
  - `gh-1743: a factory-level budget timeout (wedged judge past the total budget) falls back to the local trim instead of aborting the session` — reproduction test, **failed before the fix** (`ok: false`), now passes: run rescued, `local-trim` pass receipt, `onDone` fired once, tokens shrank, transcript starts at the trim marker, tool pairing intact, session records untouched (14 kept).
  - `gh-1743: when nothing is droppable the budget timeout keeps the failure verdict` — pins the honest failure path (no trim → `onBothRolesFailed` + `false`, no context change).
- Full suite: pending at PR time — see CI.

### Notes

- Behavior on other timeout shapes is unchanged: a per-call budget kill the structured engine recovers from (#515/#541) still resolves inside the engine; a non-timeout structured failure still falls through to the classic engine.
- The trim is in-memory only — the session JSONL keeps the full history; the next restart replays it and the pre-flight compaction retries the LLM path.

1217 lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart
# Changelog

Older entries: [CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md](CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md) — moved out
on 2026-10-09 (gh-1452): pub.dev server-rejects a publish whose
CHANGELOG.md exceeds its 262144-byte content cap, so this file keeps a
bounded recent window and `scripts/check_changelog_size.sh` fails fast when the cap is
approached. Since gh-1522 this file is CURATED-ONLY: add new lines under
`## Unreleased` and the release folds them into the tag's section at
publish-staging time — the published artifact's changelog is generated
(and trimmed under the cap by `stamp_staged_release.sh`), and the
publish job only WARNS on this repo file, so this file's size can never
block a release again.

## Unreleased

- fix(gh-1636): auto-compaction stops dumping the internal checkpoint
  summary into the console — the default report is ONE marker line
  (`● auto-compacted · engine: N → M tokens (F freed · P%)`); the records
  line + fenced summary moved behind the new `tui.showCompactionDetails`
  opt-in (default false), and the manual `/compact` still prints the full
  block. The headless log face no longer streams the summarizer deltas by
  default (the gh-1433 E4 live stream is part of the same opt-in; the
  gh-1430 `… reasoning` liveness line still covers the window). Nothing
  is lost — the summary stays in the session file, reachable via
  `compact_expand`.

- fix(test): gh-1732 — the `wrap_ansi_line_perf_test` sustained-contention
  validation leg spikes 3 of the 5 doubled runs per attempt instead of 4
  (CI run 39546301132, core shard 2/4: the old shape left exactly ONE
  real-wall-clock-timed doubled sample per attempt, and real jitter on
  that single sample — the very shape being modeled — inflated all three
  attempts' min ratios to a 3.30x best against the 3.2 bound while the
  real 500k growth legs on the same runner stayed green). 3-of-5 is the
  documented live-red shape ("≥3 of the 5 timed runs"): median-of-5
  [c,c,s] is still a spiked value, so the leg still proves the
  pre-gh-1532 median harness fails, and the min harness now rides two
  clean doubled samples per attempt.

- fix(#1705): CLI fresh-install boarding asks the provider choice FIRST —
  the same list the `/add-provider` picker shows (presets, `Custom` last) —

{"content":"### Root Cause

When a background structured compaction (`CompactionEngine.structured`) hit its 300s budget watchdog — or a gateway 504/disconnect the engine could not recover from — `AutoCompactorFactory.run()` failed fast (`hooks.onBothRolesFailed` + `return false`) in the `outcome.timedOut` branch (`lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart`). The over-window continuation funnel read `false` as "compaction exhausted" and aborted the live task (`the transcript is still ~X tokens vs a Y-token window — N compaction passes did not free it`), even though the session file kept every record and a mechanical rescue path already existed.

### Fix

- `lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart`: added `AutoCompactor.applyLocalTrimFallback({int pass})` — applies the same `_localTrimFallback()` valve the classic pass ladder ends on (keeps the most recent `keepRecentTokens`, repairs tool pairing, prefixes the `[context trimmed locally]` marker), fires the `local-trim` pass receipt and closes the `onDone` bracket exactly once. The factory's `timedOut` branch now applies this fallback instead of aborting; the both-roles-failed verdict is kept only when nothing is droppable.
- `CHANGELOG.md`: `fix(gh-1743)` entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/agent/auto_compactor_structured_budget_test.dart`:
  - `gh-1743: a factory-level budget timeout (wedged judge past the total budget) falls back to the local trim instead of aborting the session` — reproduction test, **failed before the fix** (`ok: false`), now passes: run rescued, `local-trim` pass receipt, `onDone` fired once, tokens shrank, transcript starts at the trim marker, tool pairing intact, session records untouched (14 kept).
  - `gh-1743: when nothing is droppable the budget timeout keeps the failure verdict` — pins the honest failure path (no trim → `onBothRolesFailed` + `false`, no context change).
- Full suite: pending at PR time — see CI.

### Notes

- Behavior on other timeout shapes is unchanged: a per-call budget kill the structured engine recovers from (#515/#541) still resolves inside the engine; a non-timeout structured failure still falls through to the classic engine.
- The trim is in-memory only — the session JSONL keeps the full history; the next restart replays it and the pre-flight compaction retries the LLM path.
","path":"outputs/response.md"}

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:
    # dart test --tags io
  perf:
    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open
    # budgets. Selected by --tags integration in CI; run standalone with
    # dart test --tags perf

    # omp REG parity suite (issue #810): structural diff of the committed

{"content":"### Root Cause

When a background structured compaction (`CompactionEngine.structured`) hit its 300s budget watchdog — or a gateway 504/disconnect the engine could not recover from — `AutoCompactorFactory.run()` failed fast (`hooks.onBothRolesFailed` + `return false`) in the `outcome.timedOut` branch (`lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart`). The over-window continuation funnel read `false` as "compaction exhausted" and aborted the live task (`the transcript is still ~X tokens vs a Y-token window — N compaction passes did not free it`), even though the session file kept every record and a mechanical rescue path already existed.

### Fix

- `lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart`: added `AutoCompactor.applyLocalTrimFallback({int pass})` — applies the same `_localTrimFallback()` valve the classic pass ladder ends on (keeps the most recent `keepRecentTokens`, repairs tool pairing, prefixes the `[context trimmed locally]` marker), fires the `local-trim` pass receipt and closes the `onDone` bracket exactly once. The factory's `timedOut` branch now applies this fallback instead of aborting; the both-roles-failed verdict is kept only when nothing is droppable.

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:
    # dart test --tags io
  perf:
    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open
    # budgets. Selected by --tags integration in CI; run standalone with
    # dart test --tags perf
  reg-parity:
    # omp REG parity suite (issue #810): structural diff of the committed
    # omp reference twins vs fa's pure-Dart engine renders. Fast, hermetic
    # (no PTY, no network), SKIPs when the fixtures are not captured yet.

    # runs the same suite, so hook/CI marker parity holds with no new
    # stage. Standalone: dart test test/cli/omp_reg_parity_test.dart

# Changelog

Older entries: [CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md](CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md) — moved out
on 2026-10-09 (gh-1452): pub.dev server-rejects a publish whose
CHANGELOG.md exceeds its 262144-byte content cap, so this file keeps a
bounded recent window and `scripts/check_changelog_size.sh` fails fast when the cap is
approached. Since gh-1522 this file is CURATED-ONLY: add new lines under
`## Unreleased` and the release folds them into the tag's section at
publish-staging time — the published artifact's changelog is generated
(and trimmed under the cap by `stamp_staged_release.sh`), and the
publish job only WARNS on this repo file, so this file's size can never
block a release again.

## Unreleased

- fix(gh-1636): auto-compaction stops dumping the internal checkpoint
  summary into the console — the default report is ONE marker line
  (`● auto-compacted · engine: N → M tokens (F freed · P%)`); the records

{"content":"### Root Cause

When a background structured compaction (`CompactionEngine.structured`) hit its 300s budget watchdog — or a gateway 504/disconnect the engine could not recover from — `AutoCompactorFactory.run()` failed fast (`hooks.onBothRolesFailed` + `return false`) in the `outcome.timedOut` branch (`lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart`). The over-window continuation funnel read `false` as "compaction exhausted" and aborted the live task (`the transcript is still ~X tokens vs a Y-token window — N compaction passes did not free it`), even though the session file kept every record and a mechanical rescue path already existed.

### Fix

- `lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart`: added `AutoCompactor.applyLocalTrimFallback({int pass})` — applies the same `_localTrimFallback()` valve the classic pass ladder ends on (keeps the most recent `keepRecentTokens`, repairs tool pairing, prefixes the `[context trimmed locally]` marker), fires the `local-trim` pass receipt and closes the `onDone` bracket exactly once. The factory's `timedOut` branch now applies this fallback instead of aborting; the both-roles-failed verdict is kept only when nothing is droppable.
- `CHANGELOG.md`: `fix(gh-1743)` entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/agent/auto_compactor_structured_budget_test.dart`:
  - `gh-1743: a factory-level budget timeout (wedged judge past the total budget) falls back to the local trim instead of aborting the session` — reproduction test, **failed before the fix** (`ok: false`), now passes: run rescued, `local-trim` pass receipt, `onDone` fired once, tokens shrank, transcript starts at the trim marker, tool pairing intact, session records untouched (14 kept).
  - `gh-1743: when nothing is droppable the budget timeout keeps the failure verdict` — pins the honest failure path (no trim → `onBothRolesFailed` + `false`, no context change).
- Full suite: pending at PR time — see CI.

### Notes

- Behavior on other timeout shapes is unchanged: a per-call budget kill the structured engine recovers from (#515/#541) still resolves inside the engine; a non-timeout structured failure still falls through to the classic engine.
- The trim is in-memory only — the session JSONL keeps the full history; the next restart replays it and the pre-flight compaction retries the LLM path.
","path":"outputs/response.md"}

{"content":"### Root Cause

When a background structured compaction (`CompactionEngine.structured`) hit its 300s budget watchdog — or a gateway 504/disconnect the engine could not recover from — `AutoCompactorFactory.run()` failed fast (`hooks.onBothRolesFailed` + `return false`) in the `outcome.timedOut` branch (`lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart`). The over-window continuation funnel read `false` as "compaction exhausted" and aborted the live task (`the transcript is still ~X tokens vs a Y-token window — N compaction passes did not free it`), even though the session file kept every record and a mechanical rescue path already existed.

### Fix

- `lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart`: added `AutoCompactor.applyLocalTrimFallback({int pass})` — applies the same `_localTrimFallback()` valve the classic pass ladder ends on (keeps the most recent `keepRecentTokens`, repairs tool pairing, prefixes the `[context trimmed locally]` marker), fires the `local-trim` pass receipt and closes the `onDone` bracket exactly once. The factory's `timedOut` branch now applies this fallback instead of aborting; the both-roles-failed verdict is kept only when nothing is droppable.
- `CHANGELOG.md`: `fix(gh-1743)` entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/agent/auto_compactor_structured_budget_test.dart`:
  - `gh-1743: a factory-level budget timeout (wedged judge past the total budget) falls back to the local trim instead of aborting the session` — reproduction test, **failed before the fix** (`ok: false`), now passes: run rescued, `local-trim` pass receipt, `onDone` fired once, tokens shrank, transcript starts at the trim marker, tool pairing intact, session records untouched (14 kept).
  - `gh-1743: when nothing is droppable the budget timeout keeps the failure verdict` — pins the honest failure path (no trim → `onBothRolesFailed` + `false`, no context change).
- Full suite: pending at PR time — see CI.

### Notes

- Behavior on other timeout shapes is unchanged: a per-call budget kill the structured engine recovers from (#515/#541) still resolves inside the engine; a non-timeout structured failure still falls through to the classic engine.
- The trim is in-memory only — the session JSONL keeps the full history; the next restart replays it and the pre-flight compaction retries the LLM path.

1217 lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart
# Changelog

Older entries: [CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md](CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md) — moved out
on 2026-10-09 (gh-1452): pub.dev server-rejects a publish whose
CHANGELOG.md exceeds its 262144-byte content cap, so this file keeps a
bounded recent window and `scripts/check_changelog_size.sh` fails fast when the cap is
approached. Since gh-1522 this file is CURATED-ONLY: add new lines under
`## Unreleased` and the release folds them into the tag's section at
publish-staging time — the published artifact's changelog is generated
(and trimmed under the cap by `stamp_staged_release.sh`), and the
publish job only WARNS on this repo file, so this file's size can never
block a release again.

## Unreleased

- fix(gh-1636): auto-compaction stops dumping the internal checkpoint
  summary into the console — the default report is ONE marker line
  (`● auto-compacted · engine: N → M tokens (F freed · P%)`); the records
  line + fenced summary moved behind the new `tui.showCompactionDetails`
  opt-in (default false), and the manual `/compact` still prints the full
  block. The headless log face no longer streams the summarizer deltas by
  default (the gh-1433 E4 live stream is part of the same opt-in; the
  gh-1430 `… reasoning` liveness line still covers the window). Nothing
  is lost — the summary stays in the session file, reachable via
  `compact_expand`.

- fix(test): gh-1732 — the `wrap_ansi_line_perf_test` sustained-contention
  validation leg spikes 3 of the 5 doubled runs per attempt instead of 4
  (CI run 39546301132, core shard 2/4: the old shape left exactly ONE
  real-wall-clock-timed doubled sample per attempt, and real jitter on
  that single sample — the very shape being modeled — inflated all three
  attempts' min ratios to a 3.30x best against the 3.2 bound while the
  real 500k growth legs on the same runner stayed green). 3-of-5 is the
  documented live-red shape ("≥3 of the 5 timed runs"): median-of-5
  [c,c,s] is still a spiked value, so the leg still proves the
  pre-gh-1532 median harness fails, and the min harness now rides two

{"content":"### Root Cause

When a background structured compaction (`CompactionEngine.structured`) hit its 300s budget watchdog — or a gateway 504/disconnect the engine could not recover from — `AutoCompactorFactory.run()` failed fast (`hooks.onBothRolesFailed` + `return false`) in the `outcome.timedOut` branch (`lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart`). The over-window continuation funnel read `false` as "compaction exhausted" and aborted the live task (`the transcript is still ~X tokens vs a Y-token window — N compaction passes did not free it`), even though the session file kept every record and a mechanical rescue path already existed.

### Fix

- `lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart`: added `AutoCompactor.applyLocalTrimFallback({int pass})` — applies the same `_localTrimFallback()` valve the classic pass ladder ends on (keeps the most recent `keepRecentTokens`, repairs tool pairing, prefixes the `[context trimmed locally]` marker), fires the `local-trim` pass receipt and closes the `onDone` bracket exactly once. The factory's `timedOut` branch now applies this fallback instead of aborting; the both-roles-failed verdict is kept only when nothing is droppable.
- `CHANGELOG.md`: `fix(gh-1743)` entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/agent/auto_compactor_structured_budget_test.dart`:
  - `gh-1743: a factory-level budget timeout (wedged judge past the total budget) falls back to the local trim instead of aborting the session` — reproduction test, **failed before the fix** (`ok: false`), now passes: run rescued, `local-trim` pass receipt, `onDone` fired once, tokens shrank, transcript starts at the trim marker, tool pairing intact, session records untouched (14 kept).
  - `gh-1743: when nothing is droppable the budget timeout keeps the failure verdict` — pins the honest failure path (no trim → `onBothRolesFailed` + `false`, no context change).
- Full suite: pending at PR time — see CI.

### Notes

- Behavior on other timeout shapes is unchanged: a per-call budget kill the structured engine recovers from (#515/#541) still resolves inside the engine; a non-timeout structured failure still falls through to the classic engine.
- The trim is in-memory only — the session JSONL keeps the full history; the next restart replays it and the pre-flight compaction retries the LLM path.
","path":"outputs/response.md"}

1217 lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart
# Changelog

Older entries: [CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md](CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md) — moved out
on 2026-10-09 (gh-1452): pub.dev server-rejects a publish whose
CHANGELOG.md exceeds its 262144-byte content cap, so this file keeps a
bounded recent window and `scripts/check_changelog_size.sh` fails fast when the cap is
approached. Since gh-1522 this file is CURATED-ONLY: add new lines under
`## Unreleased` and the release folds them into the tag's section at
publish-staging time — the published artifact's changelog is generated
(and trimmed under the cap by `stamp_staged_release.sh`), and the
publish job only WARNS on this repo file, so this file's size can never
block a release again.

## Unreleased

- fix(gh-1636): auto-compaction stops dumping the internal checkpoint
  summary into the console — the default report is ONE marker line
  (`● auto-compacted · engine: N → M tokens (F freed · P%)`); the records
  line + fenced summary moved behind the new `tui.showCompactionDetails`
  opt-in (default false), and the manual `/compact` still prints the full
  block. The headless log face no longer streams the summarizer deltas by
  default (the gh-1433 E4 live stream is part of the same opt-in; the
  gh-1430 `… reasoning` liveness line still covers the window). Nothing
  is lost — the summary stays in the session file, reachable via
  `compact_expand`.

- fix(test): gh-1732 — the `wrap_ansi_line_perf_test` sustained-contention
  validation leg spikes 3 of the 5 doubled runs per attempt instead of 4
  (CI run 39546301132, core shard 2/4: the old shape left exactly ONE
  real-wall-clock-timed doubled sample per attempt, and real jitter on
  that single sample — the very shape being modeled — inflated all three
  attempts' min ratios to a 3.30x best against the 3.2 bound while the
  real 500k growth legs on the same runner stayed green). 3-of-5 is the
  documented live-red shape ("≥3 of the 5 timed runs"): median-of-5
  [c,c,s] is still a spiked value, so the leg still proves the
  pre-gh-1532 median harness fails, and the min harness now rides two
  clean doubled samples per attempt.

- fix(#1705): CLI fresh-install boarding asks the provider choice FIRST —
  the same list the `/add-provider` picker shows (presets, `Custom` last) —

{"content":"### Root Cause

When a background structured compaction (`CompactionEngine.structured`) hit its 300s budget watchdog — or a gateway 504/disconnect the engine could not recover from — `AutoCompactorFactory.run()` failed fast (`hooks.onBothRolesFailed` + `return false`) in the `outcome.timedOut` branch (`lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart`). The over-window continuation funnel read `false` as "compaction exhausted" and aborted the live task (`the transcript is still ~X tokens vs a Y-token window — N compaction passes did not free it`), even though the session file kept every record and a mechanical rescue path already existed.

### Fix

- `lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart`: added `AutoCompactor.applyLocalTrimFallback({int pass})` — applies the same `_localTrimFallback()` valve the classic pass ladder ends on (keeps the most recent `keepRecentTokens`, repairs tool pairing, prefixes the `[context trimmed locally]` marker), fires the `local-trim` pass receipt and closes the `onDone` bracket exactly once. The factory's `timedOut` branch now applies this fallback instead of aborting; the both-roles-failed verdict is kept only when nothing is droppable.

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:
    # dart test --tags io
  perf:
    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open
    # budgets. Selected by --tags integration in CI; run standalone with
    # dart test --tags perf
  reg-parity:
    # omp REG parity suite (issue #810): structural diff of the committed
    # omp reference twins vs fa's pure-Dart engine renders. Fast, hermetic
    # (no PTY, no network), SKIPs when the fixtures are not captured yet.
    # Merge-blocking through the EXISTING legs: ci.yml test-core (dart test
    # runs it) and the pty-visual job (fa_omp_reg_visual_test.dart) both
    # aggregate into Quality gate; the pre-commit hook's test-core stage
    # runs the same suite, so hook/CI marker parity holds with no new
    # stage. Standalone: dart test test/cli/omp_reg_parity_test.dart

1217 lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart
# Changelog

Older entries: [CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md](CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md) — moved out
on 2026-10-09 (gh-1452): pub.dev server-rejects a publish whose
CHANGELOG.md exceeds its 262144-byte content cap, so this file keeps a
bounded recent window and `scripts/check_changelog_size.sh` fails fast when the cap is
approached. Since gh-1522 this file is CURATED-ONLY: add new lines under
`## Unreleased` and the release folds them into the tag's section at
publish-staging time — the published artifact's changelog is generated
(and trimmed under the cap by `stamp_staged_release.sh`), and the
publish job only WARNS on this repo file, so this file's size can never
block a release again.

## Unreleased

- fix(gh-1636): auto-compaction stops dumping the internal checkpoint
  summary into the console — the default report is ONE marker line
  (`● auto-compacted · engine: N → M tokens (F freed · P%)`); the records
  line + fenced summary moved behind the new `tui.showCompactionDetails`
  opt-in (default false), and the manual `/compact` still prints the full
  block. The headless log face no longer streams the summarizer deltas by
  default (the gh-1433 E4 live stream is part of the same opt-in; the
  gh-1430 `… reasoning` liveness line still covers the window). Nothing
  is lost — the summary stays in the session file, reachable via
  `compact_expand`.

- fix(test): gh-1732 — the `wrap_ansi_line_perf_test` sustained-contention
  validation leg spikes 3 of the 5 doubled runs per attempt instead of 4
  (CI run 39546301132, core shard 2/4: the old shape left exactly ONE
  real-wall-clock-timed doubled sample per attempt, and real jitter on
  that single sample — the very shape being modeled — inflated all three
  attempts' min ratios to a 3.30x best against the 3.2 bound while the
  real 500k growth legs on the same runner stayed green). 3-of-5 is the
  documented live-red shape ("≥3 of the 5 timed runs"): median-of-5
  [c,c,s] is still a spiked value, so the leg still proves the
  pre-gh-1532 median harness fails, and the min harness now rides two
  clean doubled samples per attempt.

- fix(#1705): CLI fresh-install boarding asks the provider choice FIRST —
  the same list the `/add-provider` picker shows (presets, `Custom` last) —

{"content":"### Root Cause

When a background structured compaction (`CompactionEngine.structured`) hit its 300s budget watchdog — or a gateway 504/disconnect the engine could not recover from — `AutoCompactorFactory.run()` failed fast (`hooks.onBothRolesFailed` + `return false`) in the `outcome.timedOut` branch (`lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart`). The over-window continuation funnel read `false` as "compaction exhausted" and aborted the live task (`the transcript is still ~X tokens vs a Y-token window — N compaction passes did not free it`), even though the session file kept every record and a mechanical rescue path already existed.

### Fix

- `lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart`: added `AutoCompactor.applyLocalTrimFallback({int pass})` — applies the same `_localTrimFallback()` valve the classic pass ladder ends on (keeps the most recent `keepRecentTokens`, repairs tool pairing, prefixes the `[context trimmed locally]` marker), fires the `local-trim` pass receipt and closes the `onDone` bracket exactly once. The factory's `timedOut` branch now applies this fallback instead of aborting; the both-roles-failed verdict is kept only when nothing is droppable.
- `CHANGELOG.md`: `fix(gh-1743)` entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/agent/auto_compactor_structured_budget_test.dart`:
  - `gh-1743: a factory-level budget timeout (wedged judge past the total budget) falls back to the local trim instead of aborting the session` — reproduction test, **failed before the fix** (`ok: false`), now passes: run rescued, `local-trim` pass receipt, `onDone` fired once, tokens shrank, transcript starts at the trim marker, tool pairing intact, session records untouched (14 kept).
  - `gh-1743: when nothing is droppable the budget timeout keeps the failure verdict` — pins the honest failure path (no trim → `onBothRolesFailed` + `false`, no context change).
- Full suite: pending at PR time — see CI.

### Notes

- Behavior on other timeout shapes is unchanged: a per-call budget kill the structured engine recovers from (#515/#541) still resolves inside the engine; a non-timeout structured failure still falls through to the classic engine.
- The trim is in-memory only — the session JSONL keeps the full history; the next restart replays it and the pre-flight compaction retries the LLM path.
","path":"outputs/response.md"}

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:
    # dart test --tags io
  perf:
    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open
    # budgets. Selected by --tags integration in CI; run standalone with
    # dart test --tags perf

    # omp REG parity suite (issue #810): structural diff of the committed

# Changelog

Older entries: [CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md](CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md) — moved out
on 2026-10-09 (gh-1452): pub.dev server-rejects a publish whose
CHANGELOG.md exceeds its 262144-byte content cap, so this file keeps a
bounded recent window and `scripts/check_changelog_size.sh` fails fast when the cap is
approached. Since gh-1522 this file is CURATED-ONLY: add new lines under
`## Unreleased` and the release folds them into the tag's section at
publish-staging time — the published artifact's changelog is generated
(and trimmed under the cap by `stamp_staged_release.sh`), and the
publish job only WARNS on this repo file, so this file's size can never
block a release again.

## Unreleased

- fix(gh-1636): auto-compaction stops dumping the internal checkpoint
  summary into the console — the default report is ONE marker line
  (`● auto-compacted · engine: N → M tokens (F freed · P%)`); the records
  line + fenced summary moved behind the new `tui.showCompactionDetails`
  opt-in (default false), and the manual `/compact` still prints the full
  block. The headless log face no longer streams the summarizer deltas by
  default (the gh-1433 E4 live stream is part of the same opt-in; the
  gh-1430 `… reasoning` liveness line still covers the window). Nothing
  is lost — the summary stays in the session file, reachable via
  `compact_expand`.

- fix(test): gh-1732 — the `wrap_ansi_line_perf_test` sustained-contention
  validation leg spikes 3 of the 5 doubled runs per attempt instead of 4
  (CI run 39546301132, core shard 2/4: the old shape left exactly ONE
  real-wall-clock-timed doubled sample per attempt, and real jitter on
  that single sample — the very shape being modeled — inflated all three
  attempts' min ratios to a 3.30x best against the 3.2 bound while the
  real 500k growth legs on the same runner stayed green). 3-of-5 is the
  documented live-red shape ("≥3 of the 5 timed runs"): median-of-5
  [c,c,s] is still a spiked value, so the leg still proves the
  pre-gh-1532 median harness fails, and the min harness now rides two
  clean doubled samples per attempt.

- fix(#1705): CLI fresh-install boarding asks the provider choice FIRST —
  the same list the `/add-provider` picker shows (presets, `Custom` last) —

{"content":"### Root Cause

When a background structured compaction (`CompactionEngine.structured`) hit its 300s budget watchdog — or a gateway 504/disconnect the engine could not recover from — `AutoCompactorFactory.run()` failed fast (`hooks.onBothRolesFailed` + `return false`) in the `outcome.timedOut` branch (`lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart`). The over-window continuation funnel read `false` as "compaction exhausted" and aborted the live task (`the transcript is still ~X tokens vs a Y-token window — N compaction passes did not free it`), even though the session file kept every record and a mechanical rescue path already existed.

### Fix

- `lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart`: added `AutoCompactor.applyLocalTrimFallback({int pass})` — applies the same `_localTrimFallback()` valve the classic pass ladder ends on (keeps the most recent `keepRecentTokens`, repairs tool pairing, prefixes the `[context trimmed locally]` marker), fires the `local-trim` pass receipt and closes the `onDone` bracket exactly once. The factory's `timedOut` branch now applies this fallback instead of aborting; the both-roles-failed verdict is kept only when nothing is droppable.
- `CHANGELOG.md`: `fix(gh-1743)` entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/agent/auto_compactor_structured_budget_test.dart`:
  - `gh-1743: a factory-level budget timeout (wedged judge past the total budget) falls back to the local trim instead of aborting the session` — reproduction test, **failed before the fix** (`ok: false`), now passes: run rescued, `local-trim` pass receipt, `onDone` fired once, tokens shrank, transcript starts at the trim marker, tool pairing intact, session records untouched (14 kept).
  - `gh-1743: when nothing is droppable the budget timeout keeps the failure verdict` — pins the honest failure path (no trim → `onBothRolesFailed` + `false`, no context change).
- Full suite: pending at PR time — see CI.

### Notes

- Behavior on other timeout shapes is unchanged: a per-call budget kill the structured engine recovers from (#515/#541) still resolves inside the engine; a non-timeout structured failure still falls through to the classic engine.
- The trim is in-memory only — the session JSONL keeps the full history; the next restart replays it and the pre-flight compaction retries the LLM path.
","path":"outputs/response.md"}

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:
    # dart test --tags io
  perf:
    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open
    # budgets. Selected by --tags integration in CI; run standalone with
    # dart test --tags perf
  reg-parity:
    # omp REG parity suite (issue #810): structural diff of the committed
    # omp reference twins vs fa's pure-Dart engine renders. Fast, hermetic
    # (no PTY, no network), SKIPs when the fixtures are not captured yet.

approached. Since gh-1522 this file is CURATED-ONLY: add new lines under
`## Unreleased` and the release folds them into the tag's section at
publish-staging time — the published artifact's changelog is generated
(and trimmed under the cap by `stamp_staged_release.sh`), and the
publish job only WARNS on this repo file, so this file's size can never
block a release again.

## Unreleased

- fix(gh-1636): auto-compaction stops dumping the internal checkpoint
  summary into the console — the default report is ONE marker line
  (`● auto-compacted · engine: N → M tokens (F freed · P%)`); the records
  line + fenced summary moved behind the new `tui.showCompactionDetails`

  is lost — the summary stays in the session file, reachable via

  attempts' min ratios to a 3.30x best against the 3.2 bound while the
  real 500k growth legs on the same runner stayed green). 3-of-5 is the
  documented live-red shape ("≥3 of the 5 timed runs"): median-of-5
  [c,c,s] is still a spiked value, so the leg still proves the
  pre-gh-1532 median harness fails, and the min harness now rides two
  clean doubled samples per attempt.

{"content":"### Root Cause

When a background structured compaction (`CompactionEngine.structured`) hit its 300s budget watchdog — or a gateway 504/disconnect the engine could not recover from — `AutoCompactorFactory.run()` failed fast (`hooks.onBothRolesFailed` + `return false`) in the `outcome.timedOut` branch (`lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart`). The over-window continuation funnel read `false` as "compaction exhausted" and aborted the live task (`the transcript is still ~X tokens vs a Y-token window — N compaction passes did not free it`), even though the session file kept every record and a mechanical rescue path already existed.

### Fix

- `lib/src/agent/auto_compactor.dart`: added `AutoCompactor.applyLocalTrimFallback({int pass})` — applies the same `_localTrimFallback()` valve the classic pass ladder ends on (keeps the most recent `keepRecentTokens`, repairs tool pairing, prefixes the `[context trimmed locally]` marker), fires the `local-trim` pass receipt and closes the `onDone` bracket exactly once. The factory's `timedOut` branch now applies this fallback instead of aborting; the both-roles-failed verdict is kept only when nothing is droppable.
- `CHANGELOG.md`: `fix(gh-1743)` entry under `## Unreleased`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/agent/auto_compactor_structured_budget_test.dart`:
  - `gh-1743: a factory-level budget timeout (wedged judge past the total budget) falls back to the local trim instead of aborting the session` — reproduction test, **failed before the fix** (`ok: false`), now passes: run rescued, `local-trim` pass receipt, `onDone` fired once, tokens shrank, transcript starts at the trim marker, tool pairing intact, session records untouched (14 kept).
  - `gh-1743: when nothing is droppable the budget timeout keeps the failure verdict` — pins the honest failure path (no trim → `onBothRolesFailed` + `false`, no context change).
- Full suite: pending at PR time — see CI.

### Notes

- Behavior on other timeout shapes is unchanged: a per-call budget kill the structured engine recovers from (#515/#541) still resolves inside the engine; a non-timeout structured failure still falls through to the classic engine.
- The trim is in-memory only — the session JSONL keeps the full history; the next restart replays it and the pre-flight compaction retries the LLM path.

    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file

    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),

    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
